test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I was really hoping to ________ a decent movie this time, and I came up with an undisputed classic.
solution:
The correct answer is "**unearth**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** "Unearth" means to discover or find something, especially something that was hidden or unknown**.(पता लगाना)

 
 
• Example: The archaeologists unearthed a priceless artifact.
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to use in the given sentence as the speaker was hoping to find a good movie and ended up discovering a classic.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• I was really hoping to unearth__ a decent movie this time, and I came up with an undisputed classic. 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "tirade", means a long, angry speech or rant. It is not appropriate in the given context as the speaker was hoping for a good movie, not expressing anger or frustration.(निंदा-भाषण)
 
• Option 2, "subside", means to become less intense or severe. It does not fit in the sentence as it does not convey the idea of finding a good movie.(कम होना)
 
• Option 4, "strut", means to walk with a proud, confident gait. It is not suitable in the context of finding a good movie. (अकड़)
